name: canvas-text
title: Canvas Text
description: Fills part of a headline with a canvas pattern of thin horizontal lines in shifting blues. The lines bend in gentle sine waves and stay clipped inside the letters, animating on their own.
use: One phrase of a hero headline should feel alive and carry the eye without a full hero rebuild.
avoid: The motion is continuous with no pause or reduced-motion check, and canvas-drawn text cannot be selected.
a11y: The canvas exposes the words through an aria-label, but the continuous motion has no prefers-reduced-motion check. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The second half of a large bold headline, "living visuals", shown in blue and striped with closely spaced horizontal lines. The plain first line "Turn rough ideas into" sits above in white, and the striped bands bend in soft S-curves across the glyphs.
behaves: The line bands slide and bow on a slow loop of several seconds, cycling between a few blue tones. Motion stays clipped to the letter shapes and runs on its own with no input or pause.
customise: Text, colour list, loop duration, line width and gap, curve amount, background class and overlay placement are props.
weight: moderate: A small canvas redraws a few dozen bezier lines every animation frame.
